# Asset provenance

Canvas scenery, character designs, card art, and synthesized music are original
Arctic Duet work adapted from the canonical `the-very-very-far-north` source.
The two local fonts are retained unchanged: DM Sans and Fraunces are licensed
under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Their source notices are retained in this
directory. No network assets or third-party runtime dependencies are used.
